paragraphs.text: Design's job right now is refusal.
put it simply: there are only two ways to make money in software, bundling and unbundling, and AI is speed-running the bundling. Seven likes. The same week,
shipped a font and the likes piled up.
quietly stopped selling the prompt as the product. Now it's a model that edits inside the file you already have. That's the right retreat.
named the risk. A feature can work and still make the product worse. Add enough of them and you can't feel anyone behind the software.
says the future belongs to designers who build. I'd go further: it belongs to designers who delete.
has the whole method. Remove the animations. Improve what's left. Check that it's fast.
. Someone with taste still has to write them, and know when to throw them out.
